name: libultrahdr (ultrahdr_app)
role: Ultra HDR JPEG encode and decode: SDR base plus gain map in one file
notes: 2026-11-27: Triage: assess. Fills the HDR-still gap: libavif writes AVIF, dovi-tool covers video metadata only.

2026-11-27: Lead said the formula's ultrahdr_app was unverified; Homebrew 2.0.2 ships it at bin/ultrahdr_app. Lead licence Apache-2.0 was incomplete: the repo LICENSE says MIT and Apache-2.0 together. Release v2.0.2 dated 2026-08-13.
2026-11-27: Flags are documented only in `ultrahdr_app -h` and examples/ultrahdr_app.cpp, not a man page.

2026-11-27: Evidence partial: 2.0.2 writes ISO 21496-1 gain map metadata (APP2) plus MPF and no XMP hdrgm, so readers that only parse Google XMP metadata may not see the gain map. Untested for display as HDR.

evidence.result: Partial: 9 of 10 predeclared checks pass. 128x96 SDR RGBA8888 plus HLG P3 RGBA1010102 encoded to a 7410-byte Ultra HDR JPEG (gain map 4024 bytes, MPF lists 2 images); probe reads maxContentBoost 9.462; ImageMagick and ffmpeg decode the SDR base (PSNR 50.39 dB vs input); library HLG decode highlight peak 1023/1023; plain JPEG probe exits 255; repeat encode byte-identical. KNOWN FAIL xmp_hdrgm_gain_map_max_present: no XMP in the file, metadata is ISO 21496-1 APP2. libjpeg-turbo 3.2.1, exiftool 13.50, ImageMagick 7.1.2-36, ffmpeg 9.0.2, Python 3.12.2.
evidence.scope: Ultra HDR JPEG encode from raw SDR+HLG pair, SDR base decode, library HDR decode; macOS arm64, 128x96 synthetic. XMP hdrgm absent (KNOWN FAIL). No HDR display, PQ, P010 or photos.

summary: Google's reference library and sample CLI for Ultra HDR JPEG: an SDR base JPEG plus a gain map in one file, readable as SDR everywhere and as HDR where supported. ultrahdr_app encodes from raw HDR (P010 or RGBA1010102) with an optional SDR input, and decodes back.
use_when: Ship an HDR still that falls back to SDR in any JPEG reader
Probe or decode a gain map JPEG back to HDR pixels
avoid_when: Use libavif when an AVIF still is wanted
Use dovi-tool for HDR metadata in video streams

assessment.rationale: v2.0.2 released 2026-08-13 with pushes through 2026-11-20. The Homebrew formula ships the ultrahdr_app CLI. Dual MIT and Apache-2.0 licence per the repository LICENSE. Flag reference is the help text and source; output depends on the libjpeg-turbo build.
